title: PicoShare
name: picoshare
description: Minimalist file sharing: upload any file and get a direct link to it, with no re-encoding, no size limit and an optional expiry date. Guest links let other people upload files to you. Source: https://github.com/mtlynch/picoshare

env.name: PICOSHARE_PASSWORD
env.label: Password (required)
env.description: What you'll log in with. Anything long and hard to guess, or generate one with: openssl rand -hex 16

env.name: PICOSHARE_PORT
env.label: Host port for the web UI
